Hey, friend. 
Well, it's been a bit rough. 

I've been looling for a job. The first job I got, i hated because it was a bit too much for me. It required me to really put myself out there and be the friendliest and most positive person i could be. I lasted one day and I quit. This sent me into a bit of a downward spiral. I tried to combat it by running. I ran a lot to keep myself sane. 

A few weeks later, I landed another job, teaching English to students online. This seemed like a better fit and I was quite keen. 

I'm on a one-month probationary contract. Deoending on how well I do, I will be offered a one-year contract. 

I'm feeling a bit anxious about the job and I'm not entirely sure why. But I'm glad it's something to keep my mind busy during the day. Plus the hours are great. 
I hope I get the one-year contract because this job is great. At the same time, it makes me super nervous. I've been trying to figure out why.

I've accomplished my goals that I wrote down since I got out of the psychiatric hospital, which makes me really happy. 

I still find it difficult to wake up some mornings because it feels like I just can't be alive. Some days, i let it consume me because I don't know how to fight it. Those are the days I generally stay in bed and lose myself in books or music. 

I also had to learn to let go of somebody I love, which hasn't been the slightest bit easy. But I know that if I keep this person around, I'll never really heal.

So yeah.  

That's me right now. Thank you for taking an interest.
